extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who want to create a new Wikipedia page (diagnosing why a page title isn't present and what steps to take to create or recover it). Covers account requirements, searching existing content, title conventions, and deletion/visibility troubleshooting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a prerequisite for creating a new page; if you are not autoconfirmed, consider alternative methods (article wizard, draft submission, or requesting a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a live article (e.g., not autoconfirmed), prepare a draft via the article wizard or request creation so experienced editors can review and publish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Cancel Soup" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, verify that the topic isn't covered under a different title or variant spelling to avoid duplicates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can show if the topic is mentioned elsewhere and help identify the appropriate existing article or need for a redirect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent creation / database update delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you're sure the page was just created, allow time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh; do not recreate immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When choosing a page title, verify capitalization variants and create redirects where appropriate so users searching variants find the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: If page was deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log to diagnose reasons for removal and learn how to revise or appeal if you plan to recreate content.
